services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Everything you need for a comfortable stay
services.breakfastDesc: Mornings at Akutsa begin with the scent of a home kitchen. Our breakfast is prepared with local, often homegrown ingredients — fresh bread, homemade cheese, eggs, honey, seasonal fruits and vegetables. This isn't just breakfast — it's a flavourful experience.
services.toursDesc: Discover the hidden treasures of Adjara with our experienced local guides. We offer trips to Makhuntseti Waterfall, Goderdzi Pass, historic fortresses, wine cellars and many more hidden gems. Every tour is tailored to your interests and wishes.
services.transferDesc: We can organize comfortable transfer from Batumi airport or city center directly to the guesthouse, and back.
services.transferDescription: We offer comfortable and safe transfer services across Georgia. Our experienced, licensed drivers will pick you up, drop you off, and guide you to any destination. All vehicles have passed technical inspection and are fully insured. Prices vary by route and location — contact us for a personalized quote.
services.delikaType: 4×4 mountain vehicle — perfect for off-road and mountain routes
services.minivanType: Comfortable minivan — perfect for airport transfers and city trips

attractions.title: Attractions Near Akutsa
attractions.subtitle: Discover the beauty of Adjara
attractions.item1Desc: A historic wooden mosque in the village of Akutsa, dating to the late medieval period. It preserves notable examples of traditional wooden architecture.
attractions.item2Desc: One of Georgia's most popular waterfalls, 50 meters high, on the right bank of the Acharistskali River. Accessible by car year-round.
attractions.item3Desc: A waterfall in Keda Municipality, just 100 meters on foot from where the road ends.
attractions.item4Desc: A waterfall in the village of Merisi, Keda Municipality. A walking trail leads to the falls, with a café nearby.
attractions.item5Desc: Built on a Byzantine-style substructure, this hall-type church has a western entrance and arched openings on three sides.
attractions.item6Desc: Home to a diverse collection of archaeological material found across the municipality — tools, numismatic items, and a geological collection.
attractions.item7Desc: Located in the village of Khichauri, this fortress has two sections and a window built into its wall. It is 7.1 meters long and 5 meters high.
attractions.item8Desc: A local winery in Keda Municipality. Learn about the winemaking process and taste local grape varieties.
attractions.item9Desc: A park in the center of Keda, named after a prominent Adjarian public figure — a place for rest and recreation.
attractions.item10Desc: A restaurant in Keda serving authentic Adjarian cuisine, with a welcoming atmosphere and local dishes.

rtveli.metaTitle: Rtveli Autumn Harvest Experience | Guest House Akutsa, Adjara
rtveli.metaDescription: Join our exclusive one-day Rtveli package — grape harvest, traditional foot-pressing, Adjarian culinary masterclass, and a scenic waterfall stop. Available mid-September to October near Batumi.
rtveli.heroDesc: For one magical season, the hills of Adjara turn gold. Join us for a day of grape picking, ancient traditions, and the flavours of autumn — all within an hour of Batumi.
rtveli.step1Desc: We collect you from Batumi city centre or your accommodation and head into the Adjara highlands.
rtveli.step2Desc: A scenic stop at the Merisi Waterfall — a beautiful cascade hidden in the Keda hills. Perfect for morning photos and fresh mountain air.
rtveli.step3Desc: Roll up your sleeves and join the harvest. Pick grapes by hand from the vine, then experience the ancient tradition of foot-pressing at a local vineyard near the Keda Wine Factory.
rtveli.step4Desc: Using the day's fresh harvest — grapes, walnuts, and seasonal autumn produce — you'll cook traditional Adjarian dishes with our host. Sit down together and taste what you made.
rtveli.step5Desc: We drive you back to Batumi, full of memories and flavours. Or stay the night at Guest House Akutsa and wake up to mountain views.
rtveli.overnightDesc: Extend your experience with an overnight stay at Guest House Akutsa. Wake up to mountain views, enjoy our home-cooked breakfast, and explore Adjara at your own pace the next morning.
rtveli.bannerDesc: Grape harvest, foot-pressing & Adjarian cooking — our exclusive Autumn Experience. September–October.

faq.a2: Cancellations made at least 48 hours before arrival are free of charge. Late cancellations may incur a charge equivalent to one night's stay.

faq.q5: Is breakfast included in the price?
faq.a5: Breakfast is priced separately. You can order from our menu — home-cooked meals made from local ingredients.

faq.q7: How do I get to the guesthouse?
faq.a7: The drive from Batumi takes approximately 1 hour. The final stretch is a mountain village road — we recommend using navigation or contacting us at +995 577 22 52 89 for directions. We can also arrange a transfer from Batumi airport or city center.

faq.a9: The Batumi seafront is approximately 60 km away — about a 1-hour drive.
